periods.note: 2 halves of 25 minutes; 10 minute halftime; no added time
heading_rule: Deliberate heading not allowed in 7v7 games; indirect free kick to opponents from the spot of the offence (if in goal area, taken on the goal area line).
substitution_rule: Substitutions are unlimited and can occur at any stoppage.
minimum_playing_time_rule: Philosophy (best practice, not mandated): every player should play a minimum of 50% of the time in each game.
build_out_or_retreat_line: Build-out line used (equidistant between penalty area line and halfway line). Opponents must retreat behind it when the goalkeeper has the ball in hand or on a goal kick; goalkeeper punts and drop kicks not allowed (indirect free kick). Offside applies only between the build-out line and the goal line.

quote: 7v7 (6 field players and 1 goalkeeper) ... Substitutions are unlimited and can occur at any stoppage ... 2 halves; 25 minutes halves; 10 minute halftime; No added time
notes: Game may not start or continue with fewer than 5 players on a team. Roster guidance: no more than 12 players (philosophy, not mandated). Field 55-65 x 35-45 yards; max goal 6.5 ft x 18.5 ft. periods.note: Two equal halves not to exceed 10 minutes each; half-time 5-10 minutes; no added time; playing time can be less when managed by coaches and parents

minimum_playing_time_rule: Everyone Plays: all eligible team members in attendance must play at least half of the match, excluding overtime. Late arrivals: arriving in 1st quarter must play 2 of remaining 3 quarters; arriving in 2nd/3rd quarter must play at least 1 quarter. Regions may adopt the optional 'three-quarter rule' (no player plays an entire game unless all others play at least three quarters).

periods.note: SCORY: minimum 10 / maximum 20 minutes per half, or quarters of minimum 5 / maximum 10 minutes; maximum playing time in one day 40 minutes (development fixtures) or 60 minutes (tournaments/trophy events); half-time not more than 5 minutes (Mini-Soccer Handbook)
heading_rule: No deliberate heading in matches (U7-U9 from 2024-25; U7-U10 from 2025-26). Deliberate header = indirect free kick at the point of the header, or from the nearest side line of the penalty area if inside the player's own penalty area. No heading in training in the foundation phase.
substitution_rule: Mini-Soccer: any number of substitutions may be used at any time with the referee's permission (roll-on roll-off); entry only during a stoppage; a replaced player may return; match-day squad must not exceed double the team size.
minimum_playing_time_rule: Not mandated. Mini-Soccer and Youth Futsal Handbook best practice: all team members should receive equal playing time where possible, with a recommendation of at least 50% per player per game.
build_out_or_retreat_line: Retreat line: on goal kicks the team without the ball retreats to the halfway line until the ball is in play. No offside. Throw-ins replaced by pass or dribble-in (2025/26).

notes: Squad of 10 or less for U7-U8 (Handbook). Minimum players to constitute a team: 4 (SCORY Rule 20(D)). U7-U10 do not play in leagues; maximum 3 trophy events per season. Ball size 3 confirmed in both SCORY Rule 18(C) table and the Handbook. FA 'Future Fit' changes to youth formats are announced for the 2026-27 season onwards - values here are 2025-26.

notes: Bracketed values in SCORY are chosen by each sanctioned competition.

periods.note: 20 min halves; minimum 5 min half-time break
substitution_rule: Maximum of three substitutes. Players may be rotated on and off at any time, including while the ball is in play (player off before substitute on).
minimum_playing_time_rule: Equal playing time should be a priority ensuring all players regardless of age, gender and/or ability get to take the field (stated as a priority, not a quantified minimum).
build_out_or_retreat_line: No offside. On goal-line restarts opponents must retreat to the halfway line; no throw-ins or corners.
source_title: Football Australia - Coles MiniRoos Club Football: National Playing Formats and Rules (PDF published Oct 2025; text states 'Effective from 1 January 2015')
quote: The number of players: 4-a-side with no goalkeeper, Maximum of three substitutes ... Ball size: Size 3 ... Duration of the game: 20 min halves, Minimum 5 min half-time break
notes: Field 30m x 20m; goals 2m x 1m. No heading rule appears anywhere in the document (set to null). No match results published; no points tables. A separate Football Australia 'Game Time Policy Template' (Club Changer programme) suggests EQUAL GAME TIME for MiniRoos U6-U11 and MINIMUM HALF GAME TIME for U12-U18, but it is a club-adjustable template, not a national rule.
additional_sources.title: Football Australia Club Changer - Game Time Policy Template (template, not a binding rule) | Play Football - MiniRoos FAQs ('small sided football games (4v4, 7v7 & 9v9)')

periods.note: 20 min halves; minimum 5 min half-time break
substitution_rule: Maximum of four substitutes. Players may be rotated on and off at any time during the game.
minimum_playing_time_rule: Equal playing time should be a priority (all age groups U6-U11).
build_out_or_retreat_line: No offside. Goalkeeper may not kick or drop-kick from hands; on goal kicks and goalkeeper distribution opponents must be at least 10 m outside the penalty area until the ball is in play.
source_title: Football Australia - Coles MiniRoos Club Football: National Playing Formats and Rules
quote: The number of players: 7-a-side including a goalkeeper, Maximum of four substitutes ... Ball size: Size 3 ... Duration of the game: 20 min halves
notes: Field min 40x30 m, best practice 45x35 m, max 50x40 m; goals 3m x 2m; penalty area 5m x 12m. Throw-ins and corners used from U8.

periods.note: 25 min halves; minimum 5 min half time break
substitution_rule: Maximum of five substitutes. Players may be rotated on and off at any time during the game.
minimum_playing_time_rule: Equal playing time should be a priority (all age groups U6-U11).
build_out_or_retreat_line: Offside not mentioned for U10 & 11 (no-offside statements appear only for U6-7 and U8-9). Goalkeeper may not kick or drop-kick from hands; opponents 10 m outside penalty area on goalkeeper restarts. Penalty kicks from an 8 m mark.
source_title: Football Australia - Coles MiniRoos Club Football: National Playing Formats and Rules
quote: The number of players: 9-a-side including a goalkeeper, Maximum of five substitutes ... Ball size: Size 4 ... Duration of the game: 25 min halves
notes: Field max 70x50 m, best practice 65x45 m, min 60x40 m; goal max 5m x 2m; penalty area 10m x 20m. AMBIGUOUS: the U10-11 page does not state whether offside applies.

periods.note: Maximum 30 minutes: 2 x 15 min or 4 x 7.5 min; maximum match time per player per day 60 minutes
substitution_rule: Unlimited (on the fly or at designated stoppages).
minimum_playing_time_rule: Fair Playing Time for All Players; coaches should target a minimum of 50% playing time for each player. Exception: at U7, where the match-day roster allows more players, players may not reach 50% but should play as close to equal time as possible.
build_out_or_retreat_line: Retreat line: yes (halfway line). No offside. Sideline restarts by dribble-in or pass-in.

quote: Note - Formats for illustrate purposes only at this point. This will be developed in collaboration with the game.
notes: The only current fai.ie document found that states formats by age. It gives format ranges per age band (5-7: 2v2 to 5v5; 8-11: 5v5 to 7v7; 12-14: 9v9 to 11v11; 15-16 and 17-19: 11v11) and example pitch/goal sizes (5v5 40m x 25m, 2m x 1.2m goals; 7v7 55m x 35m, 5m x 2m goals), but explicitly says formats are illustrative and will be developed with leagues. No match duration, ball size, heading, substitution or playing-time rule is published on fai.ie. The older FAI 'Player Development Plan' (2015: U8/U9 5v5, U10/U11 7v7, U12 9v9) survives only on club websites, which are not official sources, so it is NOT recorded here.
